pages.text: $(bold)Placeable Food$()$(br2)Some dishes can be placed in the world as decorations or for sharing.$(br2)$(bold)Types:$()$(br)• $(item)Plated Dishes$(): Place on blocks$(br)• $(item)Bowled Soups$(): Placeable soup containers$(br)• $(item)Cakes$(): Multi-layer edible cakes$(br2)Right-click to place, right-click again to eat.

$(bold)Multiplayer Sharing$()$(br2)Placed food can be consumed by other players, perfect for:$(br2)• Multiplayer dining parties$(br)• Base decoration$(br)• Food displays$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Different foods have different serving counts and restoration effects!
